hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN BELARUS
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Belarus 2026–2027. High European educational standards, robust medical infrastructure, and safe environment.

overview: Belarus provides world-class medical training in European state universities. The curriculum is heavily focused on hands-on practical patient diagnostics in affiliated regional teaching hospitals.

universities.desc: Premier state medical university situated in the capital city of Minsk.

universities.desc: Highly recognized state medical academy with state-of-the-art diagnostic labs.

faq.question: Is Belarus safe for Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, Belarus is rated among the safest countries in Europe with strict campus security and dedicated international hostels.

faq.question: Is NEET compulsory for Belarus?
faq.answer: Yes, NEET qualification is required by NMC to validate foreign medical degrees in India.
